resources.string: Workspaces group sessions independently of files. Switching or deleting a workspace keeps sessions and execution environments running.
Drag the handles to reorder workspaces. The order is saved immediately and also applies to the workspace selector and move dialog.
Work running in sessions shown in %1$s will stop.
Leave empty to show the profile name in lists and use the default session title.
Manage the name, icon and launch configurations. Changes apply only when you save the whole workspace.
Save to make this workspace permanent.
Start the selected configurations in order when opening a Workspace with no sessions. You can select more than one.
Leave empty to use the profile setting, or enter an absolute path. The original profile is preserved.
The referenced profile was removed. Edit this launch configuration.
Sessions become unassigned. Session processes, execution environments and files are preserved.

Manage shared directories stored independently of execution environments. Native uses host paths; Userspace Linux and supported AVF images use /mnt/term-shares/<name>. Changes apply to new local sessions or the next AVF VM boot.
Connection settings provide convenience, not Android UID isolation. Native and Userspace Linux run under the same app UID.
The shared directory was deleted or does not exist.
Applies to new sessions after saving. Existing sessions keep running. AVF connections grant explicit file-copy access only.
Use 1–64 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, starting with a letter.
Files in this shared directory will be deleted. This is separate from deleting an environment or workspace. Finish all sessions and file operations first.
File transfers create separate copies inside the VM alongside direct sharing. Requires a running VM and an image with file-transfer support. Older images with that endpoint can still transfer copies.

Direct sharing path. Requires a supported image and compatible device; applies on the next VM boot. Renaming or disconnecting does not change running mounts, so stop and start the VM to apply changes. Older unsupported images use file copies.
Copy AVF file into shared directory

VM location: /home/droid/term-transfers/directory-name/relative-path. One regular file, up to 64 MiB and 2 minutes. Directories, symbolic links, path escapes and overwriting existing files are rejected. SHA-256 is verified before publication.

UUID-environment, legacy common and retained directories are listed separately. Stop the environments using this directory and finish file writes before copying. Unrelated environment sessions continue. Originals remain at their original paths, including after environment deletion. Recover interrupted Rootless storage migrations first. Import and ZIP export support regular files and directories; links or special files cause failure with originals preserved. Limit: 2 GiB and 100,000 entries. Existing workspace links block environment deletion. Use a Full environment backup to preserve their targets as well.
